meta.label: K8S Apply (gated)
meta.description: Policy-gated kubectl mutations on a DSS-attached cluster: verb/kind/namespace whitelist enforced INSIDE this macro (apply/patch/delete/label/annotate/scale/rollout-restart; no secrets, no cluster-scoped kinds, no --all/--force). preview runs read-only twins and server dry-runs; execute stops at the first failure. The read-only K8S Insights macro is untouched.

params.name: commands_json
params.label: Commands JSON
params.description: JSON array of kubectl arg strings (without the word kubectl). Use the literal {manifest} placeholder with `apply -f {manifest}`.

params.name: manifest_yaml
params.label: Manifest YAML
params.description: Manifest for apply commands; policy-validated per document.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run
params.description: When true, execute behaves like preview.
